decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The external brickwork shall be rendered and painted to match the existing property within three months of the date of this permission

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 4 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 48 Clairvale Road.
Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the east facing flank elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and west facing wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Retention of two storey flank extension incorporating balcony to front elevation at first floor level, part two storey rear extension and single storey rear extension and front porch to dwellinghouse
